body: Read as: the bracketed word is too heavy for a three cell idea, so use one glyph from the Nerd Font vocabulary. v7 replaces [git] with a one-cell mark in a three-cell hit box. Nerd set uses U+E702 (nf-dev-git), unicode set uses U+2387, ascii falls back to g. It follows the pair pattern the theme already carries for the fold carets and the sync mark, so git-mark plus nerd-git-mark, and the existing one-cell glyph test covers all three.
mockups/v7/index.html: section 1 is the glyph table across the three sets, section 2 is rest, hover and open, and every row carries the mark instead of the word. Rows are 34 cells now, was 38.
